topic: The Windmill Problem (Computational Geometry & Convex Hulls)

sections.title: Introduction: The Setting
lecture_lines: Imagine points scattered across a plane.
A line pivots around one point.
It sweeps until it hits another.
animations: Create 5 points randomly distributed on #FFFFFF background.
Show a line pivoting around point P1.
Rotate line until it hits point P2.

sections.title: Prerequisite: Angular Sweeping
lecture_lines: Sort points by their polar angle.
The closest point becomes the pivot.
animations: Draw a circle of points around a pivot.
Sweep a radial line clockwise from the pivot.
Color points in order of angular encounter using #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Mechanical Logic: State Transitions
lecture_lines: Shift pivot to the new point.
animations: Draw lines between points P1 and P2.
Animate line rotation to identify next nearest point.
Update the pivot point to the new location.

sections.title: Core Insight: Periodicity and Convex Hull
lecture_lines: The line visits every point pair.
animations: Draw the convex hull of the points.
Animate the windmill line covering all hull edges.
Show all possible diagonals covered in sequence.
Flash the final closed loop path in #FF4500.

sections.title: Conclusion & Application
animations: Display the windmill as a path planning tool.
Animate path through a maze of obstacles.
Show the robot arm avoiding collisions safely.
